system.name: ScholarMark Automated Essay Scorer
system.intended_purpose: Provide a provisional 1-6 rubric score and feedback comments on student English-composition essays to assist teachers in summative grading.
system.deployment_context: Cloud SaaS integrated into a school LMS; teachers receive provisional scores in a review queue.

governance.owner: VP of Assessment Integrity, BrightPath Learning Systems
governance.oversight: Provisional scores are not released to students until a teacher reviews and confirms each one.

out_of_scope: Final grade of record without teacher confirmation
Scoring of essays by English-language learners without accommodation review
risks: Bias against non-standard dialects and ELL writing styles
Gaming via keyword stuffing or length inflation
Over-reliance reducing teacher engagement with student work

metrics: Quadratic weighted kappa vs. human raters: 0.79
measure.fairness: Score gaps measured across reported student first-language; ELL essays showed a 0.4-point mean under-scoring under investigation.
limitations: Trained primarily on US grade 9-12 prompts
Not validated for creative-writing or non-English submissions

mitigations: Confidence flag routes low-agreement essays to a second human reviewer
manage.monitoring: Monthly agreement audit against a teacher-graded sample, segmented by student demographics.
